topic.title: I/O Cache (IOC)

body.p: NGU solves the single bottleneck issue by moving away from the notion of a single Root complex. The IOC (IO-Cache) is one of the key components in Next Generation Uncore (NGU) based SoCs and each IOC can support a PCIe Hierarchy below it and is exposed as a Root-Bus to the software. Multiple IOCs and other coherent agents in the system and Memory Subsystem is all connected to a protocol agnostic NOC. The first version of IOC is built from existing client SoC components IOP and WRC.
